summary: Asks the network community for comments on how socket names should be structured. Two layouts are offered for the 32-bit socket number, one almost entirely arbitrary and one with defined fields. It answers a request made at the February 1971 meeting in Illinois.

eli5.summary: A socket number is like a mailbox address. This note shows two ways to build that address and asks everyone which they prefer.

questions: how should socket numbers be structured
what socket name layouts were proposed in 1971
